title: Budget-Friendly Marketing for Fitness Studios | ClubRight

facts.fact: The ClubRight blog article 'Effective Gym Marketing: Budget-Friendly Strategies for Fitness Studios' was published on 13 February 2024.
According to the ClubRight vendor's own description, its team is behind more than 1,000 UK clubs.
facts.quote: Ex-gym owners and the people behind 1,000+ UK clubs

facts.fact: ClubRight's own page shows a 4.8/5 rating based on 192 reviews.
ClubRight's own call-to-action states it has no contract, no setup fee, and offers free migration.
facts.value: no contract; no setup fee; free migration
facts.quote: No contract No setup fee Free migration 4.8/5 · 192 reviews

facts.fact: The article's illustrative example says that if only half of a studio's members each refer one friend, the membership base would still double.
facts.value: 50% of members refer one friend each; membership doubles
facts.quote: Even if only half of your members refer one friend, you'll still have doubled your membership base.
